title: Mark a chore done or undo

criteria.text: User Action: Clicks the checkbox on an open chore. Expected System Behavior: The chore moves to "Done" with the name struck through and a "Done" chip ("Late" if it was overdue). The Done count and progress card update.
criteria.note: Corrected to Figma's Late chip (team decision). Jira only mentions the Done chip.

criteria.text: User Action: Clicks the checkbox on a done chore. Expected System Behavior: The chore returns to the open list. The Done count and progress card update.
Error Condition: The change fails to save. The chore returns to its previous state. Message: "Couldn't update this chore. Please try again."
Chore card layout, Done section, and progress card: see "View the Chore List."
criteria.note: A pointer to SCRUM-7, whose criteria test the chore card, the Done section and the progress card.

criteria.text: Only the housemate a chore is assigned to can mark it done or undo it. Other housemates see no checkbox.
criteria.note: Added (team decision: only the assignee can tick a chore). Not in Jira yet.
